paite: Pharoin Gaza a gawt maa Philistia mite tungtanga jawlnei Jeremia kianga TOUPA thu hongtung:
english: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before that Pharaoh struck Gaza.

paite: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngai un, mal akipanin tui a hongkhang hi, a kuang dimin a luang let ding; Gam a tum dinga, a sunga om tengteng toh, khopi leh a sunga tengte leng; mite a kap ding ua, gama mi tengteng a mau tuaituai ding uh.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing stream, and shall overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein; and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.

paite: A sakol hat chinte leitot gingin, a kidou kangtala ging dopdopin, a kangtalai thot gingte in, pate a lungleh ua, a tate uh en lou jenin.
english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

paite: Philistia mi tengteng lohna ni, Tura leh sidon akipana panpihmi om sunte sattanna ni jiakin, TOUPAN tuipi gei Kaphthora om laite a hihse sin ngala.
english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains: for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

paite: Gaza mite lu a honggiau ta, Askelon a chimit taa, a gam phaizanga teng laite; bangtan ki-at ding na hia?
english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?

paite: Aw TOUPA namsau, na om kinken ma bangtan ahia? Na pai ah kikhumin; khawl inla om kinken ve.TOUPAN hihding a honpiak ngal leh bangchin na om kinken thei dia? Askelon leh tuipi gei tunga gamtang dingin, a honseh ngal aleh.
english: You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you be quiet? Put up yourself into your scabbard; rest, and be still.

paite: TOUPAN hihding a honpiak ngal leh bangchin na om kinken thei dia? Askelon leh tuipi gei tunga gamtang dingin, a honseh ngal aleh.
english: How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.
